notablePrerequisites: Polukranos has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Pay {1}{B}{G} to have Polukranos fight Crystalline Crawler.
Vigor prevents the damage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Polukranos and four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Remove three +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
